paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 71b. The notice adds: “Rava said.”[^1]

notes.text: The notice adds Rava said. The two stored William Davidson scalars at Yevamot 71b give Rava's explanation followed by Rav Kahana son of Rav Nechemyah's own explanation; they do not form a Kahana-reports-Rava chain. The source fragment is translated without inventing such a chain or adding the legal cases.
